text.p: Concurrent Computer Corp said Monday it reduced its stake in CyberGuard Corp to 4.99 percent or 342,178 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Concurrent said it sold 249,500 shares of CyberGuard between December 11 and 13 at prices ranging from $12.00 to $13.50 a share.

Concurrent also disclosed that on December 9 it gave Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, a unit of Bear Stearns Cos, an option to buy 300,000 shares of CyberGuard common stock that it holds at an exercise price of $9.74 a share. The option expires on June 9, 1997, Concurrent said.
Concurrent did not specify any reasons for its latest transactions on stock of CyberGuard, a Ft. Lauderdale, Fla.,-based provider of computer security software.
Concurrent, a computer supplier, is also based in Ft. Lauderdale.
